metadata.question: Was the vegetation anomaly in February 21-28 2019 (compared to the long-term average of the same month from 2003-2017) worse in Namibia than Zimbabwe?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS NDVI (MOD13A2 or MOD13Q1) for long-term analysis (available from 2000+) - Period 1: February 21-28, 2019 (target period) - Period 2: February 21-28, 2003-2017 (long-term average) - Location: Country boundaries for Namibia and Zimbabwe 2. Masking strategy: - Use MODIS quality flags to mask unreliable pixels - The question is about vegetation anomaly, so we should mask clouds/poor quality data 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for Feb 21-28, 2019 for both countries - Calculate mean NDVI for Feb 21-28, 2003-2017 (average across years) for both countries - Anomaly = 2019 value - long-term average - A more negative anomaly = worse vegetation condition - Compare: If Namibia's anomaly < Zimbabwe's anomaly, answer A (Yes, Namibia worse) - Otherwise answer B (No, Zimbabwe worse or similar) - Handle cases: C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define countries const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017'); const namibia = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Namibia')).geometry(); const zimbabwe = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Zimbabwe')).geometry(); // MODIS NDVI collection (16-day composite, 250m) const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1') .select('NDVI'); // Target period: Feb 21-28, 2019 const target2019 = modis .filterDate('2019-02-21', '2019-03-01') .filterBounds(namibia.union(zimbabwe)); // Long-term average: Feb 21-28, 2003-2017 const longTermImages = []; for (let year = 2003; year <= 2017; year++) { const yearCol = modis .filterDate(`${year}-02-21`, `${year}-03-01`) .filterBounds(namibia.union(zimbabwe)); if (yearCol.size().getInfo() > 0) { longTermImages.push(yearCol.mean()); } } // Check if we have data const target2019Size = target2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target 2019 images: ${target2019Size}`); if (target2019Size === 0) { console.log('No data for 2019 period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (longTermImages.length === 0) { console.log('No data for long-term average period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate means const img2019 = target2019.mean().multiply(0.0001); // MODIS scale factor const imgLongTerm = ee.ImageCollection(longTermImages).mean().multiply(0.0001); // Calculate statistics for both countries const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }); // Namibia 2019 const nam2019Stats = img2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: namibia, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const nam2019Mean = nam2019Stats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const nam2019Count = nam2019Stats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); // Namibia long-term const namLTStats = imgLongTerm.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: namibia, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const namLTMean = namLTStats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const namLTCount = namLTStats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); // Zimbabwe 2019 const zim2019Stats = img2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: zimbabwe, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const zim2019Mean = zim2019Stats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const zim2019Count = zim2019Stats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); // Zimbabwe long-term const zimLTStats = imgLongTerm.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: zimbabwe, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const zimLTMean = zimLTStats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const zimLTCount = zimLTStats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels if (nam2019Count === 0 || namLTCount === 0 || zim2019Count === 0 || zimLTCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for null values if (nam2019Mean === null || namLTMean === null || zim2019Mean === null || zimLTMean === null) { console.log('Calculation returned null values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Calculate anomalies const namAnomaly = nam2019Mean - namLTMean; const zimAnomaly = zim2019Mean - zimLTMean; console.log(`Namibia 2019 NDVI: ${nam2019Mean.toFixed(3)} (${nam2019Count} pixels)`); console.log(`Namibia LT Avg NDVI: ${namLTMean.toFixed(3)} (${namLTCount} pixels)`); console.log(`Namibia Anomaly: ${namAnomaly.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Zimbabwe 2019 NDVI: ${zim2019Mean.toFixed(3)} (${zim2019Count} pixels)`); console.log(`Zimbabwe LT Avg NDVI: ${zimLTMean.toFixed(3)} (${zimLTCount} pixels)`); console.log(`Zimbabwe Anomaly: ${zimAnomaly.toFixed(3)}`); // More negative anomaly = worse condition if (namAnomaly < zimAnomaly) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
